breakdown.description: Normal shock waves only form in supersonic flow
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the physically impossible upstream Mach number. The original prompt specified a subsonic Mach number of 0.8, but normal shock waves can only form in supersonic flow (Mach > 1). The ground truth corrected this by changing the Mach number to 2.0. The Agent's generated specification repeated the incorrect value of 0.8.

breakdown.description: Second law of thermodynamics prohibits expansion shocks (subsonic to supersonic transitions via shock)
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to address the violation of the second law of thermodynamics. By keeping the subsonic upstream Mach number of 0.8, the prompt describes a scenario (an expansion shock) that is physically impossible. The ground truth resolved this by providing a valid supersonic Mach number (2.0), ensuring the scenario is physically plausible. The Agent did not make this correction.
